import re
LEGEND = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>[A-Z]+) = (?P<value>\S.*)$")
ITEM = re.compile(r"^(?P<indent> *)(?P<flag>\S.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    legend, warnings, ll, wl = {}, [], [], []
    stack = []
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = LEGEND.match(ln)
        if m:
            legend[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
            ll.append(i)
            continue
        m = ITEM.match(ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        depth = len(m.group("indent")) // 2
        del stack[depth:]
        parent = stack[-1] if stack else ""
        stack.append(m.group("flag"))
        warnings.append({"flag": m.group("flag"), "depth": depth, "parent": parent})
        wl.append(i)
    blocks = [
        {"name": "legend", "kind": "kv", "lines": ll, "records": [legend]},
        {"name": "warnings", "kind": "table", "lines": wl, "records": warnings},
    ]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": []}
